title: Left-endpoint sum
text: Divide [a,b] into $$n$$ equal pieces of width $$dx=\frac{b-a}{n}$$. $$L_n$$ adds f at the left end of each piece, then multiplies by dx.

title: Evaluate
text: $$dx=1$$ and the left endpoints are $$-2$$, $$-1$$, $$0$$, $$1$$. The values of f are $$\frac{1}{5}$$, $$\frac{1}{2}$$, $$1$$, $$\frac{1}{2}$$, which also add to $$2.2$$.
